title: The Long Night Begins
ongoing: Until next Dawn: Day Phase has only 2 actions per player.

title: An Eye Watches the Sky
immediate: Pre-warning. The Eye of Terror boss arrives next Dawn at a random house tile.
art_notes: A single floating eye over rooftops

title: The Eye of Terror Arrives
immediate: Place the Eye of Terror at a random house tile.
ongoing: While Eye is on the map: Each Dawn
art_notes: draw 1 extra Threat at its location. It festers Doom +2 each Dawn.
column7: Giant fleshy eye with antennae fronds

title: The Eye Splits
immediate: The Eye of Terror splits into 3 Terror Beak Threats placed at adjacent tiles.
ongoing: Eye is removed from the map.

title: Hunger Pangs
art_notes: Stomach rumble in a dark room

title: Screams Down the Street
immediate: Each player loses 1 Sanity. The player with the lowest Sanity loses 2 more.
art_notes: Open mouth shapes against blank windows

title: Power Goes Out Citywide
immediate: All Battery tokens in resource bags are returned to the supply.
ongoing: Until next Dawn: Charlie checks affect every location.

title: Your Friend Looks Wrong
immediate: The player to your left loses 2 Sanity and reveals one Item from their hand.

title: A Glimpse of the Truth
immediate: Reveal a Clue card from the Market deck (search through it). Place it face-up.
ongoing: If found: it cannot be claimed until Day 6.

title: The Calm Before
ongoing: Until next Dawn: All Charlie checks are paused — gather while you can.
art_notes: Eerie still air with leaves frozen mid-fall

title: Gravity Feels Wrong
immediate: All players lose 1 Health. Movement costs +1 action this day.
ongoing: Until next Dawn: Rest restores no Health.
art_notes: Furniture hanging from the ceiling of a suburban room

title: You Lost a Day
immediate: Day counter advances by 1 (skip a day). Doom +1. All players lose 1 Hunger.
art_notes: A calendar with a page torn out

title: The Walls Are Closer
immediate: Each house tile loses 1 character capacity (max 4 instead of 5). Excess players must move at Dawn.
ongoing: Until next Dawn: houses feel smaller.
art_notes: A hallway that narrows into nothing

title: One of You Was Gone This Morning
immediate: The player with the fewest items loses all items in hand. They reappear at a random tile.
ongoing: Until next Dawn: that player gets +1 action (adrenaline).
art_notes: An empty sleeping bag and a trail of footprints

title: An Offering at the Door
immediate: Choose: sacrifice 3 Food to reduce Doom by 2 OR ignore it and all players lose 1 Sanity.
art_notes: A circle of salt and bone fragments on a welcome mat

title: It Hunts the Herd
immediate: Each character at the most-populated location loses 1 Sanity.
ongoing: Tonight the most-populated location draws +1 Threat.
art_notes: A single enormous eye counting small figures huddled around a kitchen table
